# simulate.bold.simulate_bold { #fmrimod.simulate.bold.simulate_bold }

```python
simulate_bold(
    design_matrix,
    betas,
    noise_sd=1.0,
    ar_coeffs=None,
    n_voxels=1,
    rng=None,
)
```

Simulate BOLD time series from a design matrix and true betas.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name          | Type                | Description                                            | Default    |
|---------------|---------------------|--------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| design_matrix | NDArray             | Design matrix, shape ``(n, p)``.                       | _required_ |
| betas         | NDArray             | True coefficients, shape ``(p,)`` or ``(p, V)``.       | _required_ |
| noise_sd      | float               | Standard deviation of noise.                           | `1.0`      |
| ar_coeffs     | NDArray             | AR noise coefficients for temporally correlated noise. | `None`     |
| n_voxels      | int                 | Number of voxels to simulate (if betas is 1-D).        | `1`        |
| rng           | np.random.Generator | Random number generator.                               | `None`     |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type    | Description                       |
|--------|---------|-----------------------------------|
|        | NDArray | Simulated data, shape ``(n, V)``. |
